setups.text: Those last three candles look like cat ears. Cats land on their feet.
{stockName} has {nameLen} letters in it. Names that long don't quit.
It moved {movePct}%. My rent did that once. It never came back down.
The chart looks like stairs. Nobody builds stairs to go down.
The price ends in {digit}. I have never liked that number.
This candle is exactly as tall as I am. I stopped growing in high school.
{count} messages already. When people talk this much, somebody gets thirsty.
It's {clock}. My dog gets excited around now too. He's asleep ten minutes later.
That candle is very tall and very thin. Tall thin things fall over.
Everyone is typing LFG. Nobody has said where we are going.
It got quiet. Libraries are quiet. People in libraries are building something.
That last candle looks like an exclamation mark. Those only come at the end of a sentence.
{stockName} just took a breath. You have to breathe. It's a rule.
Whoever sold the top is washing their hands right now. After that they get bored.
It turned at {clock}. That's when I nap. I always feel better after.
It bent at the same angle as my umbrella. I threw that umbrella away last year.
Nobody is talking. My class went like this right before the teacher walked in.
Everyone is startled. Startled people drop things.
It's falling as fast as the elevator in my building. That elevator always stops at the lobby.
It moved {movePct}%. I lost that much weight once. It all came back.
That candle looks like an icicle. Icicles hang around until spring.
{count} messages asking for help. I don't know who they are asking.
{stockName} is ₩{price} now. That's easier to read than before. I like numbers I can read.
Whoever just bought big, their hand shook and they clicked twice. That's why it was double.
The person who just bought is on the edge of their chair. You can't sit like that for long.
Something big just came in. Big hands hit the wrong button.
The buyer can't get up for water now. Thirst makes you sharp. Or it doesn't.
Somebody bought the very top. The view is nice up there. Call it an admission fee.
That fill was loud. Loud cars go fast.
The person who just bought is counting. I counted for them. It's ₩{price}.
Whoever caught that just leaned off the back of their chair. Lean forward and you buy again.
Someone caught it on the way down. It's polite to catch things that fall.
The person who caught that has big hands. It's also a big knife.
Someone thinks this is the floor. The floor has no opinion.
The person who caught it is holding their breath. Nobody holds it for {minutes} minutes.
Whoever picked that up will brag tomorrow. Or say nothing. One of the two.
Whoever just sold big has light shoulders now. Light shoulders want to carry something.
Someone threw it all at once. People who do that don't look back. I don't know what's back there either.
The seller is pretending not to watch the chart. Nobody can pretend for more than three minutes.
A lot just left. A room looks bigger when you move the boxes out. Big rooms get visitors.
The seller dusted off their hands. Dust goes up first. Then it settles.
It keeps crossing ₩{round}. All those zeros are heavy. Heavy things don't like to move.
₩{round} exactly. Round numbers feel good. My mother said never buy anything while you feel good.
It just passed ₩{round}. I didn't feel anything on my birthday either.
Everyone is standing around ₩{round}. A restaurant with a line is a good restaurant.
Nothing is happening. Who invented stocks, though? Were they down on it?
It's quiet. I read {stockName} backwards. It didn't mean anything.
The chart only goes sideways. Crabs only go sideways. Crabs still get where they're going.
It's {clock}. Nobody is talking. I think you all know something.
{stockName} hasn't moved off ₩{price}. I don't move on Mondays either.
I've been measuring candles for an hour. I don't have a ruler, so I used my finger. One and a half knuckles.
Market's open. I just brushed my teeth. I've never lost on a day I brushed first. I've never bought either.
Good morning. The first {stockName} candle is going the same way as my mood. I don't know my mood yet.
It's {clock}. The early bird gets the worm. Nobody asks the worm.
I have a good feeling today. I had one yesterday too. Don't ask about yesterday.
Almost closing. Everyone rushes right before the end. Same as the bathroom.
It's {clock}. The last train is always crowded. People on it still get home.
I didn't look at {stockName} once today. It didn't look at me either. We're even.
Closing soon. I learned nothing today. I'll be here tomorrow.
They say time in the market beats timing the market. I have been in this chat for an hour. Nothing beat anything.
People keep saying to the moon. The moon is 384,400 km away. Nobody has checked the fuel.
They say the trend is your friend. I checked. It has not texted me back.

I believe in it. See above.
